title: Barriers and enablers to activity
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:35Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Barriers and enablers to activity
card: anything that makes it harder for a person to be active, such as the cost of club fees or a lack of safe places to play.
anything that makes it easier for a person to be active, such as a friend who trains with them or a free local program.
The same factor can be either one. Family, peers, gender, income, community and cultural norms can help or hold back activity, depending on the person.
Cultural norms are shared beliefs about what is normal or expected. If a community expects girls to stay home after school, that norm can be a barrier to sport for them.
draft.remember: A factor is a barrier or an enabler depending on whether it makes activity harder or easier for that person.

a.q: Which of these is an example of a barrier to physical activity?
opts: Club fees that a family on a low income cannot afford
A friend who invites a student to join a weekly run
A free community program held at the local oval
Parents who walk to the park with their children
a.why: Cost makes it harder for a person to take part, so the fees are a barrier. The other three make activity easier, so they are enablers.
a.clue: Which one makes it harder to be active?

b.q: Priya's friends all play netball, and they ask her to join their team. Her family cannot afford the fees, so she stays home. Which describes Priya's situation?
opts: Her peers are an enabler and her income is a barrier
Her peers are a barrier and her income is an enabler
Her peers and her income are both enablers
Her peers and her income are both barriers
b.why: Her friends make it easier to join, so they are an enabler. The fees make it harder, so her income is a barrier. Both factors act on her at the same time, and they do not have to push the same way.
b.clue: Ask of each factor: does it make activity easier or harder?

a.best: Club fees that a family on a low income cannot afford

b.best: Her peers are an enabler and her income is a barrier
